newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait will park arms funds in U.S. t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait will park arms funds in U.S. t-bills.

text.p: Washington will invest Kuwait's arms procurement funds in American treasury bills, a Kuwait finance ministry official said on Saturday.

U.S. and Kuwaiti officials will sign an accord on Sunday in Kuwait allowing Washington to invest on behalf of Kuwait its Foreign Military Sales (FMS) account, Finance Ministry General Accounts Manager Abdullah al-Mansour told Reuters.
Mansour declined to disclose the size of the account.

As part of government-to-government arms deals, Kuwait makes regular deposits into the account to pay for military hardware worth billions of dollars, including F/A-18 warplanes, M1A2 main battle tanks, anti-missile Patriot missiles and Hawk air defence batteries.
